text.실행 중인 에이전트가 위키를 검색·읽기·고치게 하고 그 기록을 남긴다: Lets running agents search, read and edit the wiki and records what they do
Server administrator settings for limits on the wiki tools agents use during runs.
text.실행 하나에서 에이전트들이 위키 페이지를 쓰고 옮기고 지울 수 있는 최대: Maximum number of times the agents in one run can write, move and delete wiki pages. Above it, only that tool fails and the run continues. Leave empty for no limit.
text.에이전트가 위키를 너무 많이 고치거나, 긴 실행에서 쓰기가 막힐 때 바꾸: Change this when agents edit the wiki too much, or when writes get blocked in long runs.
text.앞 노드의 결과를 위키 페이지에 덧붙이거나 바꿉니다. 에이전트를 부르지: Appends or replaces the previous node's result on a wiki page. Doesn't call an agent.
text.앞 노드의 결과를 위키 페이지에 씁니다. 에이전트(LLM)를 부르지 않습: Writes the previous node's result to a wiki page. Doesn't call an agent (LLM).
Wiki to edit. Pick one of the running project's wikis.
Pick the wiki that keeps the result.
text.쓸 페이지 경로입니다(확장자 없음). 중괄호 변수로 실행마다 바꿀 수 있: Path of the page to write (no extension). Variables in braces can change it for each run.
text.앞 노드가 넘긴 값(글이 아니면 JSON): Value passed by the previous node (JSON if it isn't text)
Add variables to change the path, for example one page per date.
One of: append at the end, replace one section, replace the whole page.
Pick append if you don't want to remove existing content.
Heading to replace with Replace section. Only the content under that heading changes.
Set this when the write mode is Replace section.
Content to write. input in braces is the value passed by the previous node.
Change this to add a heading or date around the previous node's result.
text.페이지가 없을 때 이 틀로 만들고 내용을 그 뒤에 붙입니다. 비우면 내용: If the page doesn't exist, it's created from this template and the content is added after it. Leave empty to write only the content.
Pick one when you want new pages to get the wiki rule's front matter and table of contents.
Title passed to the new page template. Leave empty for the template's own title.
Set this when you use a new page template and want to choose the title.
One line to add to the page history. Leave empty to add nothing.
Set this to make the changes this node writes easy to spot in the History tab.
text.에이전트에게 위키 도구(검색·읽기·목록·링크·쓰기·옮기기·지우기)와 위키: Gives agents wiki tools (search, read, list, links, write, move, delete) and wiki rule guidance, and sets permissions per wiki.

codes.wiki.access_invalid: The merged wiki access settings don't match the expected shape, so wiki tools aren't given
